title: Valid Survey Simulations with Limited Human Data: The Roles of Prompting, Fine-Tuning, and Rectification

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the relative error between LLM-generated survey population estimates and ground-truth human population parameters across dietary, economic, and political survey items.
Comparing the estimation error of LLM-simulated dietary survey responses against ground-truth human data specifically for male and female respondent subgroups.

Evaluating the relative error of model-generated survey estimates compared to actual human responses across different racial and ethnic subgroups (e.g., Non-Hispanic White, Non-Hispanic Black, Mexican American).
Measuring the disparity in survey estimation accuracy between LLM simulations and real human data across different household income brackets.
